newsitem.title: UK: Siebe slides after breaking technical prop.
newsitem.headline: Siebe slides after breaking technical prop.

text.p: Shares in Siebe Plc were on the slide on Friday, after the price fell below key support, dealers said.
Siebe shares were down 28.5 pence, or 3.05 percent, to 906p by 1130 GMT in volume of 1.5 million, while the FTSE-100 index was 13.3 points, or 0.30 percent, lower at 4,375.2.
Siebe opened today at 931p, decisively below the 935-945p area which has provided intra-day lows on several occasions over the past six months, prior to which it had been a resistance level.
"The key supports went and that was that," a British bank dealer said, adding his bank's technical analyst said there was another 60p downside on the charts.
Siebe had been consolidating in a 940-960p range over the past week, after falling from highs around 1050p in March.
